name: Accelerator Mass Spectrometry Technique-Aligned Procedure Profile (amsTAPP)
abstract: Accelerator Mass Spectrometry extension of the base TAPP definition. CORE-ONLY DRAFT: the native technique layer is empty. AMS has no ADA detail schema and no technique-specific property in any ADA record, so there was nothing to seed one from and none was invented. This registers the procedure skeleton and needs Phase 0 seed papers before it says anything AMS-specific. Generated from draftTAPPs/AMS_TAPP_draft_v2.csv by tools/build_tapp.py.
